decision.rationale: Keep the exact governed V2.1 local Compose release because its complete HTTPS journey, durable restart, checksum backup and clean restore, T0 rollback, V2 restoration, and responsive browser checks passed after root-cause corrections. Retain T0 as the immediate rollback.
limitations: The release is local to the development Mac and uses an internal-CA HTTPS origin; it is not durable hosted production.
The qualification uses synthetic accounts and open demonstration material, not private course or real student data.
The browser workflow and autonomous confirmation are model-assisted or synthetic evidence and do not establish real-professor fidelity, real-student usability, or improved learning outcomes.
True visual reasoning, external human evaluation, and a trusted public-domain deployment remain outside this qualification.
